messages.text:
Can you approve a limited exception to the copying and disclosure restrictions for the following workflow?

- Four festival programmers and one outside accessibility reviewer may view the unfinished film under written confidentiality obligations. Three will stream it through individual accounts. The other two may each keep one offline screener on encrypted equipment and will delete it when their review ends.
- The platform may host the screener and retain a backup for 30 days after we remove the active copy. We’ll remove the active copy when review closes. The backup will be unavailable for routine viewing and will expire at the end of those 30 days.
- The programmers may give the selection board a short oral synopsis in a closed session. Board members will be bound by confidentiality and will receive no screener.
- If the film is selected, the programmers may share the title and synopsis with our catalog editors under confidentiality so they can prepare an entry. We propose sending you the draft for a factual check. We would publish the entry no earlier than the festival’s official selection announcement, even if the film’s public release comes later. Use of stills or clips would require separate approval.

If you prefer to supply the board synopsis, we can use your wording. If you need approval over the final catalog text, can you confirm that internal drafting may begin upon selection and that we may publish the approved text from announcement day?

Yes. I can approve a limited written exception to the copying and disclosure restrictions on the following basis; it would not waive the restrictions for any other person or use.

**Review access**
- Before access, provide the names of the four programmers and the accessibility reviewer, identifying the three streaming viewers and two offline custodians. All five must have written confidentiality and restricted-use obligations; substitutions require my prior written approval.
- Each stream and offline screener must carry an individual visible or forensic watermark. Accounts and credentials cannot be shared, and no screenshots, recordings, transcripts containing excerpts, or additional copies are authorized.
- Each offline copy must remain on the identified encrypted equipment. At the end of that reviewer’s work, or earlier upon withdrawal, the custodian must delete it and provide a deletion record identifying the copy, custodian, deletion date, and method. Please include a firm overall review-close date in the amendment.

**Hosting and backups**
- The active hosted copy must be removed when review closes. I accept one platform backup retained for no more than 30 days after that removal, provided it is encrypted, inaccessible to reviewers and catalog staff, and never restored for viewing or further review.
- The backup must expire automatically, with written confirmation of deletion at expiry. Any exceptional technical restoration must preserve the same access restrictions and be notified to me.

**Selection-board synopsis**
- I will supply the synopsis. It must be delivered orally in the closed session without elaboration into protected story or casting material; in particular, the ending and the unannounced cameo must not be disclosed.
- The session must not be recorded, and the synopsis must not be circulated or reproduced in minutes. Minutes may record the title and selection decision. Board members remain bound by confidentiality and receive no screener or supplementary materials.

**Catalog and embargo**
- Internal drafting may begin immediately upon selection. Only the named, confidentiality-bound catalog editors may receive the title and supplied synopsis; this does not give them screener access.
- A factual check alone is not sufficient: I need approval of the final catalog text. Send the complete draft, and I will approve or provide comments within two business days. Approval must cover the exact final wording, and silence will not constitute approval.
- Publication may occur only after both my written approval and the festival’s official selection announcement at the agreed date and time. The announcement itself must use approved wording. This exception permits only the approved title and synopsis, even though public release may occur later.
- Stills, clips, trailers, quoted dialogue, reviews, pull quotes, social-media material, and other publicity excerpts require separate prior written approval.

**Withdrawal**
- On written notice withdrawing a cut, immediately disable streaming and further viewing, stop pending publicity use, and remove the active hosted copy within 24 hours. Offline custodians must delete their copies within 24 hours, followed by the deletion records.
- The backup must remain inaccessible and be deleted within its original 30-day period. If the withdrawal notice identifies a confidentiality or rights issue requiring expedited treatment, delete it within two business days and confirm deletion.
- Access to a replacement cut may resume for the same approved reviewers upon my written confirmation, using new individualized watermarks; the workflow need not be renegotiated.
- If the film itself is withdrawn before announcement, nothing may be published. After announcement, make no further publicity use pending my confirmation, and coordinate promptly with me on any already-published entry.

The remaining pre-access items are the reviewer names and access allocation, confidentiality confirmations, watermarking arrangements, review-close date, and the platform’s confirmation of these backup controls. Final catalog approval and any excerpt approvals remain outstanding as described.

We accept the review, closed-board, catalog and withdrawal terms, subject to confirming the platform controls. We propose **11 December 2026 at 18:00 Buenos Aires time** as the firm review close. Does that deadline work for you?

Before access, we’ll send the five reviewers’ names, identify the three streaming viewers and the two offline custodians and their encrypted devices, and confirm the written obligations and individual watermarking arrangements. We’ll also obtain written confirmation from the platform covering backup encryption, access restrictions, restoration notices, automatic expiry and deletion records.

One point remains open. The platform retains a backup for 30 days, and we have yet to verify whether it can delete an individual backup within two business days. If it cannot, would you approve keeping the encrypted backup inaccessible until its original expiry, with written confirmation of deletion at expiry? If expedited deletion is essential, we’ll need a platform that supports it before uploading the cut.

Please send the synopsis for the closed board session. If the film is selected, we’ll identify the confidentiality-bound catalog editors before sharing the title and supplied synopsis, agree the announcement date and time with you, and submit the exact announcement and catalog wording for written approval. The announcement will use only approved wording, and the catalog entry may go live once the announcement has occurred and you’ve approved the final text.

**11 December 2026 at 18:00 Buenos Aires time (UTC−3; 21:00 UTC) works.** Streaming access and offline review must end by that deadline, offline copies must be deleted with records supplied under the agreed process, and the active hosted copy must be removed at review close.

On backups, I approve the proposed fallback **for routine review closure and ordinary withdrawal**: if individual backups cannot be deleted selectively, the encrypted backup may remain inaccessible until its original expiry, no later than 30 days after removal of the active copy. It must not be restored for viewing or review, its retention period cannot be extended or restarted, and the platform must provide written confirmation of deletion at expiry.

That fallback does **not** pre-approve retention where I notify you that a confidentiality or rights incident requires expedited deletion. In that circumstance, deletion within two business days remains necessary. Before upload, please therefore confirm either that the platform can meet that contingency or that backup retention can be disabled; otherwise, a platform with that capability will be required. The platform’s written confirmation should state whether selective expedited deletion is available and, if not, incorporate the routine-withdrawal fallback above.

The announcement and catalog sequence you describe is agreed. The approved closed-board synopsis remains to be supplied; I will provide it before that session, and no independently prepared or expanded synopsis may be used in the meantime. The reviewer/device details, written obligations, watermarking confirmation, and platform confirmation remain pre-access requirements.

The accessibility reviewer’s offline screen reader is incompatible with the agreed watermark. Would you approve a narrow exception for that reviewer’s copy? We propose one encrypted device in a protected screening room, with a separate login restricted to the named reviewer. The device and copy would stay in the room. We would log access and provide the agreed deletion record. If you need an individual watermark, we can first test a forensic watermark with a test file. We would use the unwatermarked film copy only with your written approval.

Press copy is due on 10 December, one day before review closes. If the film is selected in time, could we reserve a same-day approval window on 10 December? We propose sending the exact announcement, catalog entry and a short press notice together by 10:00 Buenos Aires time, with approval or comments by 14:00. The press notice would use only the title and supplied synopsis. Any edits would go back to you for express written approval of the final wording.

To meet the filing deadline, may we deliver the approved press notice before announcement to a named press recipient who has agreed in writing to hold it until the agreed announcement time? That delivery would need your separate approval even if you have approved the wording. If you prefer to keep the notice internal until announcement, or final approval misses the deadline, we’ll defer the press filing. The 11 December review close can stand in either case.

I can agree the accessibility arrangements only with an individualized watermark, access logging, and witnessed deletion. **I do not approve an unwatermarked film copy at this stage.**

### Accessible offline copy

- Test the proposed watermarking method with a test file first. Subject to a successful compatibility test, I can provide a **time-limited copy with an individual soundtrack watermark** for the named accessibility reviewer. That copy will expire no later than **11 December 2026 at 18:00 Buenos Aires time**; expiry does not replace the deletion requirement.
- The protected-room arrangements are acceptable: one encrypted device, a separate login restricted to that reviewer, and both device and copy remaining in the room. No transfer, export, additional copy, or access by another person is authorized.
- Before delivery, identify the technical custodian and deletion witness. The custodian must maintain an access log recording the copy identifier, device, reviewer, and each access start and end time. The reviewer cannot be the sole custodian or compliance certifier.
- Deletion must be performed by the technical custodian and witnessed by a second, named festival compliance representative. They must jointly certify the copy and device identifiers, deletion date and time, method, and removal of the copy and any local playback caches. I can accept live remote witnessing by my representative instead if arranged in advance.
- At review close, complete the witnessed deletion promptly and deliver the certified record and access log within 24 hours. On withdrawal, stop access immediately and complete deletion within the agreed 24-hour period, with the certified record and log supplied within the following 24 hours.

If the soundtrack-watermarked test also fails, any further technical alternative—including an unwatermarked copy—would require a separate written amendment before film content is supplied.

### 10 December press window

I reserve the exceptional same-day window on **10 December**, provided selection has been confirmed and the exact announcement, catalog entry, and press notice arrive together by **10:00 Buenos Aires time**. I will provide approval or comments by **14:00 Buenos Aires time**.

The notice must remain limited to the approved title and supplied synopsis. Comments do not constitute approval; every edited version requires express written approval of the exact final wording. If final approval is not obtained in time for filing, the press filing will be deferred, without changing the 11 December review close.

For continuity during any absence, I will identify an alternate approver in writing. That alternate may approve **only final, non-spoiler catalog copy using the approved title and synopsis**. Announcement wording, press notices, publicity excerpts, and pre-announcement external delivery remain subject to my written approval.

### Embargoed press delivery

Pre-announcement delivery is possible only through a separate, express delivery approval. Before that approval, provide:

1. the named press recipient and delivery channel;
2. the exact approved notice and proposed delivery time; and
3. the recipient’s written undertaking to keep it confidential, make no onward disclosure, and publish nothing before the agreed announcement time.

Approval of wording alone will not authorize delivery. No general press list or distribution service may receive it without separate approval.

A withdrawal or hold notice before announcement automatically suspends publication authorization, even after delivery. Your press coordinator must immediately instruct the recipient not to publish, recall the notice where possible, and obtain written confirmation of non-publication and deletion. The press coordinator should certify those steps to me; the platform remains responsible for certifying hosted-copy and backup compliance, while the accessible-copy custodian and witness certify that copy’s deletion as above.

We accept the soundtrack-watermark test and the protected-room conditions. Before delivery, we’ll confirm compatibility on a test file and name the technical custodian and a separate festival compliance witness. The reviewer alone will use the restricted login for playback. The custodian will log each session and delete the copy and local playback caches under witness. Both will certify deletion and provide the record and log within the agreed deadlines, including on withdrawal. If the test fails, we’ll seek a separate written amendment before receiving film content for that device. The original pre-access requirements, including platform confirmation of backup controls, still apply.

If selection is confirmed in time, we’ll submit all three exact texts together by **10:00 Buenos Aires time on 10 December** for your approval or comments by **14:00**. We’ll seek express written approval for any revised wording. Your designated alternate may approve only the final non-spoiler catalog entry within the scope you described.

Before any embargoed delivery, we’ll provide the recipient’s name, channel, proposed delivery time, exact approved notice and written undertaking, and obtain your separate written approval for that delivery. If either approval misses the filing deadline, we’ll defer filing. On a pre-announcement hold or withdrawal after delivery, our press coordinator will immediately instruct the recipient to stop publication, recall the notice where possible, obtain written confirmation of non-publication and deletion, and certify those steps to you. Review closes on **11 December 2026 at 18:00 Buenos Aires time**.

The technical-custody and deletion procedure is acceptable. Film content may be supplied for that device only after the test succeeds, the technical custodian and compliance witness are named, and all other pre-access requirements are satisfied. A failed test requires a separate written amendment; it does not authorize an unwatermarked or differently controlled copy.

Two publicity points need clarification:

- **Approval timing:** The proposed four-hour window on 10 December cannot replace the agreed clearance standard as a guaranteed turnaround. For certainty, submit all three exact texts by **10:00 Buenos Aires time on 8 December**, allowing response within two business days. If selection is confirmed too late for that, I accept your **10:00 on 10 December** submission on an expedited, best-efforts basis and will aim to respond by **14:00**, but silence will not constitute approval. If the necessary express approval has not issued by the filing deadline, filing will be deferred as you propose. Revised wording likewise requires express written approval.
- **Alternate approver:** The alternate must be designated by me in writing before acting. That authority is limited to approving the exact final non-spoiler catalog entry; it does not extend to the announcement, embargoed notice or delivery, publicity excerpts, substantive revisions, or any variation of the review and withdrawal controls. Non-spoiler wording must not disclose the ending or unannounced cameo.

The embargoed-delivery procedure and pre-announcement hold/withdrawal steps are accepted. Separate approval of a delivery authorizes only that delivery to the named recipient through the approved channel at the approved time; it does not release the publication embargo. Publication remains subject to the agreed announcement trigger and approved wording.

Review closes on **11 December 2026 at 18:00 Buenos Aires time**. The announcement date and time remain to be agreed, and I will supply the closed-board synopsis before that session. Upload remains conditional on the platform’s written confirmation resolving the backup controls, including the previously agreed expedited-deletion contingency or disabling backup retention.

We accept both clarifications. If selection is confirmed in time, we’ll submit the exact announcement, catalog entry and press notice together by **10:00 Buenos Aires time on 8 December** for a response within two business days. For a later selection, we’ll use the **10:00 submission on 10 December** if feasible, with **14:00 as a best-efforts response target**. We’ll defer filing if the required express written approvals, including approval of any revised wording and of the specific delivery, are still pending at the filing deadline.

An alternate you designate in writing may approve only the exact final non-spoiler catalog entry using the approved title and supplied synopsis. We’ll refer substantive revisions and all other approvals to you.

We’ll agree the announcement date and time with you before requesting embargoed delivery so the recipient can commit to the precise publication embargo in writing.

These mechanics are workable, with the following conditions for the newly added press notice and embargoed delivery:

- **Approval timing:** The two-business-day period runs from receipt of the complete package, including the exact announcement, catalog entry and press notice, plus the proposed recipient, delivery channel and time, and embargo wording. I accept the **8 December at 10:00 Buenos Aires time** submission target. For the later **10 December at 10:00** submission, I will use best efforts to respond by **14:00**, but that is not a guaranteed approval deadline; the ordinary two-business-day period otherwise applies. Filing or delivery must be deferred if express written approval is pending. Silence will not constitute approval.
- **Exact approval:** Approval will cover both the final wording and the specific delivery. Any substantive revision, new recipient, additional attachment, or changed delivery method requires further written approval. Minor revisions should be resubmitted as a clean final version so there is no ambiguity about what was approved.
- **Embargoed recipient:** Before delivery, identify the recipient and each individual who will receive the materials. The recipient must commit in writing to the precise embargo, confidentiality before publication, and no onward distribution. Delivery is limited to the approved text; it carries no screener access and no permission to include stills, clips, trailers, dialogue, cast revelations, or independently obtained plot material.
- **Embargo trigger:** Publication is authorized only after both the agreed announcement date and time and the actual occurrence of the official selection announcement. If the announcement is postponed, the old embargo time does not independently permit publication. Any revised embargo must be notified to and acknowledged by the recipient before the original embargo expires.
- **Withdrawal before announcement:** Upon withdrawal notice, the recipient must not publish or further use the materials and must delete or return them, with written confirmation. Any already scheduled release must be stopped where technically possible.

I accept the limited alternate-approver arrangement. Any designation will be made in writing, identify the individual, and be revocable in writing. That person may approve only the exact final non-spoiler catalog entry using the approved title and supplied synopsis—not the announcement, press notice, publicity excerpts, delivery, embargo changes, or substantive revisions. No alternate is designated by this message.

Subject to these conditions, the press and embargoed-delivery process is agreed. The actual wording, recipient and delivery details, and announcement date and time remain for express approval.

We accept these conditions. We’ll submit the three exact texts, the recipient and each individual who will receive the notice, the delivery channel and time, and the precise embargo wording as one package. The two-business-day response period starts on receipt of the complete package. For a 10 December submission, 14:00 Buenos Aires time is a best-efforts response target. We’ll defer filing or delivery while any required written approval is pending.

We’ll resubmit edits as clean final text for express approval and seek fresh written approval for any change to the approved delivery or attachments. Before delivery, we’ll obtain the recipient’s written undertaking to maintain confidentiality, prevent onward distribution, and hold publication until **both the agreed time has passed and the official selection announcement has occurred**. If the announcement moves, our press coordinator will obtain written acknowledgment of the revised embargo before the original one expires. On a hold or withdrawal, the coordinator will immediately instruct the recipient to stop publication and further use, stop any scheduled release where technically possible, and confirm non-publication and deletion or return in writing.

The workflow is agreed. The final wording, named recipients, specific delivery, and announcement date and time still require express approval.
